# Embedded Emissions: 49,710.00 tCO2e

## Required Inputs

| Input | Value | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code | 7207 11 90 (semi-finished products of iron or non-alloy steel) | In table |
| (b) Country of production | China | Listed for this CN code |
| (c) Quantity | 15,000 tonnes | Provided |

All three inputs are present, so the ruleset permits a definitive figure.

## Factor Selection

From the row matching CN 7207 11 90 and China, the default SEE is **3.314 tCO2e/t**.

## Calculation

Embedded emissions = SEE × quantity
= 3.314 tCO2e/t × 15,000 t
= **49,710.00 tCO2e**

*Note:* This assumes "Chinese" means China is the country of production, which is what the ruleset uses to select the factor. If the steel was only shipped from China but produced elsewhere, the factor and result would change.
